pregame.pressurePoint: Stanford run game vs Notre Dame run defense. Notre Dame is No. 11 of 138 against the run (29%). Stanford ranks No. 111 in rush success rate (39%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Notre Dame erases the run. Stanford gets pushed into passing downs, and that is where this defense makes its money. Watch Stanford's yards per carry through the first quarter. Under 3 and the game plan has to change.
